name: Captain Danuvin
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Captain Danuvin helps hold Westfall's frontier together. He works with the People's Militia, directing volunteers and recruits to patrol roads and drive back Gnolls and outlaws. His orders protect the supply lines and farmlands from hostile hands.

sections.title: Holding the Hill
sections.body: Captain Danuvin coordinates patrols from Sentinel Hill's fortified tower. Stormwind's regular garrison has withdrawn, leaving Westfall's defenses badly weakened. He depends on travelers, farmhands, and volunteer fighters to keep some order across the plains.

sections.title: Patrolling the Frontier
sections.body: Captain Danuvin focuses on the roads and open lands around Sentinel Hill. Riverpaw Gnolls raid near the central outposts, so he sends patrols to thin their packs and secure the perimeter. His orders help keep marauders and opportunists from surrounding the camp.

faq.q: Where can I find Captain Danuvin?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin is at Sentinel Hill, the Alliance outpost in central Westfall. He is usually near the fortified tower overlooking the road.

faq.q: What faction does Captain Danuvin represent?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin serves the Alliance and supports Westfall's local defenders. He works closely with Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia.

faq.q: What duties does he assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin assigns recruits to patrol the plains and drive back Riverpaw Gnolls advancing on Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: Why is Danuvin relying on volunteers instead of the Stormwind Army?
faq.answer: Stormwind has left Westfall without garrison troops. Captain Danuvin and the leaders at Sentinel Hill rely on mercenaries and militia recruits.

faq.q: Does Danuvin have connections outside of Westfall?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin's ties are to Westfall, his homeland. He has vowed to stand by the citizens who stayed, so he focuses on the plains and roads around Sentinel Hill.

faq.q: What is his role compared to Gryan Stoutmantle?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle leads the People's Militia and directs Westfall's broad defense. Captain Danuvin handles field tactics, road patrols, and the Gnoll threat near the base.

angles.text: Captain Danuvin is one of the few military figures upholding order in Westfall despite the crown's neglect. Alliance recruits can help defend the realm.
As a warrior, you can put martial discipline and strength to work against Gnoll packs and help clear the highway.
As a human, you can help Captain Danuvin defend your homeland and keep Stormwind's breadbasket from raiders and beasts.
